The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>I found no hard breaches of the documented standards. There are two vocabulary breaches against CLAUDE.md and several Fowler smells. The smells are judgement calls.\n\n**(a) Documented-standard violations**\n\nThe hard constraints in CLAUDE.md and the checklist all hold. There are no root-absolute `href`/`src`, `url(` or `&lt;image&gt;` in the scenes or templates, and no `&lt;script&gt;` (a test enforces this). `body_html | safe` still comes from `markdown.to_html`. No dependency was added, `site/` wasn't touched, and the export path for drafts is unchanged. Nothing conflicts with ADR-001/002/003.\n\nThe vocabulary rule (\"Use the vocabulary in CONTEXT.md… update the glossary rather than using both\") is broken in two places:\n1. **\"club\"** — the hunk `# posts share its scene; the seeded club pages have their own` in `app/export.py` and the test name `test_each_seeded_club_page_…`. CONTEXT says *Avoid: The club* (it means neither the fan club nor Rayados). \"Pages\" or \"fan-club pages\" is the right word. The ticket's own wording, \"club page\", caused this. This is a breach, but a mild one.\n2. **\"story\"** — `.story`, `--story`, \"one story clock\", \"The home page's story\" in `home.html`, `goal.html` and `style.css`. \"Story\" is an *Avoid* word under **Post**, and here it means something else (the home page's scroll narrative). That concept has no glossary term. Either add one to the **Scene** entry (e.g. \"goal story\") or rename it.\n3. Related: the pre-existing `_cerro_de_la_silla.html` comment calls the banner \"the scene\". Under the new glossary, the banner is not a Scene. This is outside the diff, but the new glossary entry is what makes it inconsistent.\n\nTest style follows convention: per-file `inside()`/`text()` helpers, names mapped to the #10 criteria, and a docstring in the T08 voice.\n\n**(b) Baseline smells (judgement calls)**\n\n- **Duplicated Code**\n  - All 11 scenes repeat the same `&lt;svg class=\"scene scene-X\" data-scene=\"X\" viewBox=\"0 0 1600 1000\" preserveAspectRatio=\"xMidYMid slice\" aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\"&gt;` wrapper, each naming the scene three times. A `{% call scene(name) %}` macro in `_parts.html` would replace it.\n  - `referee.html` and `touchline.html` share the same backdrop: roof at y 150, stand at 176/290, `crowd(4, 204, …)` with the same shirt colours, pitch at y 466. `goal.html` and `default.html` are near-copies of it.\n  - The skin palette `[\"#b98258\", \"#e0b48a\", \"#8d5b3a\"]` is re-typed in 7 files.\n  - The crowd keyframe `to { transform: translateY(-5px) }` is re-declared per scene (`default-bob`, `referee-bob`, `touchline-bob`, `board-bob`, `goal-bob`).\n  - The rayas flag (a white rect plus three navy stripes) is hand-drawn in 5 scenes.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**\n  - The goal's beat timing is spread over three files: the keyframe percentages in `goal.html`, the `.caption:nth-of-type(1..4) { margin-bottom: 85vh/70vh/115vh/15vh }` rules in `style.css`, and the caption order in `home.html`. A comment documents the link, but the position selectors aren't scoped to `.story`, so they break silently if captions are added or reordered.\n  - `--story` is defined in `style.css` and used in `goal.html`.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the scene is chosen three different ways. Topics use `TOPIC_SCENES[key]`, pages use `PAGE_SCENES.get(slug, DEFAULT_SCENE)`, and the home page overrides `{% block scene %}`. The `export.py` comment says \"The home page carries the goal scene\", but the code for that lives in a template.\n- **Primitive Obsession** (low): `scene: str` is a bare template stem joined into a path by `\"public/scenes/\" ~ scene ~ \".html\"`. Tests cover every value in the maps, so a typo would be caught.\n- **Speculative Generality** (minor): the `scene-&lt;name&gt;` class is used only by `.scene-goal`. It is dead in the other 10 scenes.\n- **Mysterious Name** (minor): `_parts.html` (the crowd macro's file) and the macro's `cls` parameter.\n\nI didn't run anything. The tests and mypy results are the ones you reported.</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>93908</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>11</tool_uses><duration_ms>134554</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

The new tests don't check these, but the existing `tests/test_t08_look.py` does, across every exported page, and it still passes. Every page in the export has the stripes, the stadium and the disclaimer, and the home page has the banner. No page has a `&lt;script&gt;`, a path starting with `/`, or an image.\n\n**(b) Not asked for**\n- **Three extra caption cards on the home page.** Spec: *\"a short caption naming the moment… inviting the reader to scroll.\"* The page has four cards: \"Minuto 90… Van 1–1\", \"¡Gol de Suazo!\" and \"¡Rayados campeón!\" on top of the one asked for. \"Van 1–1\" is a fact the ticket doesn't give. I checked it against the ticket's Wikipedia source: Castro scored for Cruz Azul at 77', so it was 1–1 at the 90th minute, and the claim is correct.\n- **Layout changes on every public page.** The body is now a full-height column, `main` has more space on top, and the footer's top margin can grow to 16rem. These are not logos, so this is minor.\n\n**(c) Done, but slightly off**\n- **\"El gol del campeonato\" overstates the moment.** Spec: *\"The moment (checked, keep it exact)… Rayados champions, 6–4 on aggregate.\"* At 1–1 Rayados already led 5–4 on aggregate, so Suazo's goal sealed the title rather than won it. Safer wording: \"el gol que selló el campeonato\". Everything else matches exactly: 13 Dec 2009, Estadio Azul, the second leg, 1–2, De Nigris 54', Suazo 90', \"global 4–6\", the 26 on the shirt, and the scoreboard going from 90' 1–1 to 1–2.\n- **The \"Desliza hacia abajo\" invitation** stays on screen with reduced motion on, when scrolling changes nothing. The spec allows this, but it's a small mismatch.\n- **Everything else matches the ticket:**\n  - The slug keys in `app/export.py` are NFC.\n  - The scene table matches row for row.\n  - Text sits on 96% white cards.\n  - The header bands and footer are solid.\n  - Every drawing is hidden from screen readers.\n  - Nothing outside `.scene` moves.\n\nThe files that matter are `/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/public/home.html` (the captions) and `/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/public/style.css` (the layout and reduced-motion rule). {"parentUuid":"2c72a76a-585f-4cdd-8c47-37c2e2421d9c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg4iyUer6dz3HryacpRvQ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_014ryim9MdKKbWD4fnTiHpQG","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/public/scenes/_parts.html","content":"{# Drawing parts the scenes share, in the scenes' 1600 x 1000 frame. Import with\n   {% from \"public/scenes/_parts.html\" import scene, crowd, ... %}. #}\n\n{# Every scene's <svg>: the 1600 x 1000 frame, cropped around its middle to fill the\n   screen, hidden from screen readers, and named by data-scene. Use as\n   {% call scene(\"referee\") %}...{% endcall %}. #}\n{% macro scene(name) -%}\n<svg class=\"scene scene-{{ name }}\" data-scene=\"{{ name }}\" viewBox=\"0 0 1600 1000\"\n     preserveAspectRatio=\"xMidYMid slice\" aria-hidden=\"true\" focusable=\"false\">\n  {{- caller() }}\n</svg>\n{%- endmacro %}\n\n{# One of three skin tones, picked by any whole number, so a crowd looks mixed. #}\n{% macro skin(n) %}{{ [\"#b98258\", \"#e0b48a\", \"#8d5b3a\"][n % 3] }}{% endmacro %}\n\n{# Rows of fans across the whole width, heads at y, y + gap, ... Each row is one\n   <g class=\"crowd-row\">, started a little after the row above it, so the bob in\n   style.css ripples up the stand. #}\n{% macro crowd(rows, y, shirts, gap=60) -%}\n  {% for row in range(rows) %}\n  <g class=\"crowd-row\" style=\"animation-delay: -{{ (row * 0.35) | round(2) }}s\">\n    {% for i in range(48) %}{% set x = 18 + i * 34 + (row % 2) * 17 %}\n    <rect x=\"{{ x - 12 {"parentUuid":"73977427-f74d-4a64-afbd-04561d194b1c","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"dbdfe7d7-2184-486c-b03e-4ab5f27f086f","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01AhqVasF1yDPexuQ39cGhJq","type":"tool_result","content":"T08: The leader updates the site with one button, and the site gets its final look\n\n- A leader-only Actualizar el sitio button on the dashboard (POST\n  /admin/site-update, with CSRF token) runs the export, then the upload to\n  GitHub Pages, and reports each step: \"Sitio generado ✓ · Subido a GitHub ✓\".\n  A failed upload says so in plain Spanish and the export still counts; a\n  failed export uploads nothing and says so too.\n- From the console, the upload never waits on git: it cannot ask for a\n  password, and a stalled connection gives up after two minutes. cms deploy,\n  typed in a terminal, works as before.\n- Every export, from the button or `cms publish`, records its time; the\n  leader's dashboard shows it as \"Sitio generado por última vez\".\n- The upload is passed into create_app, so tests hand over a fake. An autouse\n  fixture makes any test app built without one refuse to upload and export to\n  a temporary folder, so no test reaches GitHub or site/.\n- The update_site route is declared leader-only in Policy, so the\n  access-control test covers it; members get 403.\n- The home page has an inline Cerro de la Silla banner and every public page\n  a stadium silhouette above the disclaimer, both drawn for this site as\n  inline SVG: no image files, crest, logos or photos. Checked by hand at\n  390 px: no sideways scrolling on the public home page, the dashboard, the\n  content list or the post editor.\n- A test checks the seed against the spec's whole demo data list, run from\n  .env.example. CONTEXT.md gains Upload (Subir).\n\nCode review findings and resolutions are on #9.\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>\n\nCloses #9\n\n---\nBASE_URL=<unset>\n 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+)","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"5fad48a8-5040-404f-bfcc-c818a9e87fd8","timestamp":"2026-10-15T21:25:57.304Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"T08: The leader updates the site with one button, and the site gets its final look\n\n- A leader-only Actualizar el sitio button on the dashboard (POST\n  /admin/site-update, with CSRF token) runs the export, then the upload to\n  GitHub Pages, and reports each step: \"Sitio generado ✓ · Subido a GitHub ✓\".\n  A failed upload says so in plain Spanish and the export still counts; a\n  failed export uploads nothing and says so too.\n- From the console, the upload never waits on git: it cannot ask for a\n  password, and a stalled connection gives up after two minutes. cms deploy,\n  typed in a terminal, works as before.\n- Every export, from the button or `cms publish`, records its time; the\n  leader's dashboard shows it as \"Sitio generado por última vez\".\n- The upload is passed into create_app, so tests hand over a fake. {"parentUuid":"db2b6528-329c-487a-a770-5532404b8f30","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg4jGZZVm76LKsPSKvMP2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01SiLnMU1pENLSaDpN16VJ5i","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-maximo-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/0cb99604-9df4-4255-b74b-a6b01df92d4b/scratchpad/t09-review.md","content":"## `/code-review` findings for T09 and how each was resolved\n\nThe review compared uncommitted work against `98dad86` along two separate axes, each run by its own sub-agent.\n\n### Spec (against this ticket's acceptance criteria and spec #1)\n\nNothing is missing. Every topic page, the four seeded pages, an extra page and the posts carry the right scene, in the tests and in a seeded demo export. The scene table matches row for row. Every fact in the captions matches the ticket: 13 Dec 2009, Estadio Azul, second leg, Cruz Azul 1–2 Rayados, De Nigris 54', Suazo 90', global 4–6, the 26.\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | **Slightly off:** \"hace el gol del campeonato\" overstates the moment. At 1–1 Rayados already led 5–4 on aggregate, so Suazo's goal sealed the title rather than won it. | **Fixed.** The caption now says \"Al 90', Humberto Suazo, con el 26, sella el campeonato: Cruz Azul 1–2 Rayados, global 4–6.\" |\n| 2 | Motion (scroll-driven, played once on load, still under reduced motion) is checked by hand only. | **Kept.** The agreed test seam is the export only. Before writing tests, the owner chose not to add a CSS-shape test. The checks are by hand in headless Chromium (see Verification). |\n| 3 | The banner, stripes, stadium, disclaimer and \"no image files\" rules are not asserted by the new tests. | No change. `tests/test_t08_look.py` and `tests/test_t03_export.py` already assert them on every exported page, and they still pass. |\n| 4 | **Not asked for:** three more caption cards (minute 90, the goal, the title) besides the one naming the moment. \"Van 1–1\" is not in the ticket. | **Kept.** Before building, the owner chose the \"story stage\" layout, with about three screens of captions (13 Dec 2009 → minute 90 → the goal, 1–2 → champions, global 4–6). The reviewer checked \"1–1 at the 90th minute\" against the ticket's Wikipedia source: Cruz Azul scored at 77'. |\n| 5 | **Not asked for:** layout changes on every public page. The body is now a full-height column, `main` has a gap on top, and the footer a wider one above it. | **Kept.** These make the scene visible above and below the content card. The column keeps a short page's footer at the bottom instead of floating over its scene. |\n| 6 | Text drawn into scenes (\"ALBIAZUL\", \"ESTADIO\", \"TU LUGAR\", \"PRÓXIMOS PARTIDOS\"), and a calendar that lights up Saturdays. | **Kept.** These are signs, not logos. The calendar has no month name and no fixtures, so it claims no real dates. |\n| 7 | \"Desliza hacia abajo\" stays under reduced motion, when scrolling no longer moves the scene. | **Kept.** The reader still scrolls to read the four captions, which tell the story in words. |\n\n### Standards (CLAUDE.md, CONTEXT.md, SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md, ADRs, and the code-smell baseline)\n\nThere are no hard violations. Published HTML has no root-absolute paths, `url(`, `<image>`, `src=` or `<script>`. Markdown still goes through `markdown.to_html`. No dependency was added, `site/` was not touched, and drafts still never reach the export.\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Vocabulary: \"club page\" in a comment and a test name. CONTEXT.md says *Avoid: the club*. | **Fixed.** It is now \"the four seeded pages\", and the test is `test_each_seeded_page_carries_its_own_scene_and_any_other_page_the_default_scene`. |\n| 2 | Vocabulary: \"story\" (`.story`, `--story`) is an *Avoid* word under **Post**, used here for something with no glossary term. | **Fixed.** The new **Scene** entry names it: \"The home page's scene is the **goal story**\". The code uses \"goal story\" for that and nothing else. |\n| 3 | The banner's comment called it \"the scene\", but under the new glossary the banner is not a Scene. | **Fixed.** It now says \"the drawing\". |\n| 4 | Duplicated Code: all 11 scenes repeated the same `<svg class=\"scene …\" data-scene viewBox preserveAspectRatio aria-hidden>` wrapper. | **Fixed.** A `{% call scene(\"…\") %}` macro in `scenes/_parts.html` holds the frame (1600 × 1000, cropped around its middle, hidden from screen readers), and every scene uses it. |\n| 5 | Duplicated Code: the skin palette was retyped in 7 files, the rayas flag hand-drawn in 5, and the crowd's bob keyframe re-declared in each scene. Referee and touchline drew the same stand backdrop. | **Fixed.** `_parts.html` now has `skin(n)`, `rayas(x, y, w, h)` and `day_stand()`. The crowd macro gives each row `class=\"crowd-row\"`, and the bob is declared once in `style.css`. The fans' stand overrides it to jump. |\n| 6 | Shotgun Surgery: the goal's timing was spread over `goal.html` (keyframes), `style.css` (caption gaps by `:nth-of-type`) and `home.html` (caption order), and `--story` was defined in one file and used in another. | **Fixed.** `goal.html` holds the beats and defines the `--story` timeline. `home.html` holds each caption's gap inline, beside its text, with a comment naming the beat it lines up with. `style.css` keeps only the caption's look. |\n| 7 | Repeated Switches: the scene was chosen in three ways, and the home page's choice lived in a template. | **Fixed.** `export.py` holds every choice: `HOME_SCENE`, `TOPIC_SCENES`, and `PAGE_SCENES` with `DEFAULT_SCENE`. The home template includes `scene` like any other page, inside its story. |\n| 8 | Primitive Obsession (low): the scene is a bare string joined into a template path. | **Kept.** A test covers every value in the maps, so a typo fails `export_site`. A type for 11 template names adds nothing a reader needs. |\n| 9 | Speculative Generality (minor): the `scene-<name>` class is used only by the goal. | **Kept.** The macro now writes it in one place. Scene CSS scopes by it (`.scene-goal`, and now `.scene-fans-stand .crowd-row`). |\n| 10 | Mysterious Name (minor): `_parts.html` and the crowd macro's `cls` parameter. | **Partly fixed.** `cls` is gone, because the crowd carries its own class. **Kept:** `scenes/_parts.html` reads as \"the scenes' shared parts\", like the other `_` partials beside it. |\n\n**Verification:** `uv run pytest` gives 230 passed (226 before this ticket; the 4 new tests are in `tests/test_t09_scenes.py`). `mypy app scripts/seed_demo.py` reports no issues. The test seams agreed before writing tests: what the export writes. That covers the home page's goal scene and caption, a scene per topic shared by its posts, a scene per seeded page with the default for any other slug, and no `<script>` on any page.\n\nThe rest was checked by hand in headless Chromium, on a site exported from the seed plus one extra page:\n\n- **Layout at 390 × 844 and 1280 × 720:** `scrollWidth == innerWidth` on the home page, all five topics, a post and all five pages, and the text sits on light cards.\n- **Scroll-driven:** with scroll-driven animation, scrolling the home page plays the run, the shot (the keeper dives the wrong way), the net, 1–1 → 1–2, the confetti and the cup, each caption passing during its beat. The Alineación magnets slide from the tray into the 4-3-3.\n- **Reduced motion:** with the reduced-motion rule applied, the home page and Alineación show their final frames.\n- **No scroll-driven support:** with the `@supports` block removed, the goal story plays once on load: running at 1 s, 1–2 at 5 s, the cup at 10 s, where it stays.\n- **Short page:** a page too short to scroll shows the final formation, and its footer stays at the bottom.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1277,"cache_read_input_tokens":313227,"output_tokens":3216,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":186},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1277,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3216,"cache_read_input_tokens":313227,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1277,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1277},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01SiLnMU1pENLSaDpN16VJ5i":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-maximo-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/0cb99604-9df4-4255-b74b-a6b01df92d4b/scratchpad/t09-review.md","content":"## `/code-review` findings for T09 and how each was resolved\n\nThe review compared uncommitted work against `98dad86` along two separate axes, each run by its own sub-agent.\n\n### Spec (against this ticket's acceptance criteria and spec #1)\n\nNothing is missing. Every topic page, the four seeded pages, an extra page and the posts carry the right scene, in the tests and in a seeded demo export. The scene table matches row for row. Every fact in the captions matches the ticket: 13 Dec 2009, Estadio Azul, second leg, Cruz Azul 1–2 Rayados, De Nigris 54', Suazo 90', global 4–6, the 26.\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | **Slightly off:** \"hace el gol del campeonato\" overstates the moment. At 1–1 Rayados already led 5–4 on aggregate, so Suazo's goal sealed the title rather than won it. | **Fixed.** The caption now says \"Al 90', Humberto Suazo, con el 26, sella el campeonato: Cruz Azul 1–2 Rayados, global 4–6.\" |\n| 2 | Motion (scroll-driven, played once on load, still under reduced motion) is checked by hand only. | **Kept.** The agreed test seam is the export only. The checks are by hand in headless Chromium (see Verification). |\n| 3 | The banner, stripes, stadium, disclaimer and \"no image files\" rules are not asserted by the new tests. | No change. `tests/test_t08_look.py` and `tests/test_t03_export.py` already assert them on every exported page, and they still pass. |\n| 4 | **Not asked for:** three more caption cards (minute 90, the goal, the title) besides the one naming the moment. \"Van 1–1\" is not in the ticket. | **Kept.** Before building, the owner chose the \"story stage\" layout, with about three screens of captions (13 Dec 2009 → minute 90 → the goal, 1–2 → champions, global 4–6). The reviewer checked \"1–1 at the 90th minute\" against the ticket's Wikipedia source: Cruz Azul scored at 77'. |\n| 5 | **Not asked for:** layout changes on every public page. The body is now a full-height column, `main` has a gap on top, and the footer a wider one above it. | **Kept.** These make the scene visible above and below the content card. The column keeps a short page's footer at the bottom instead of floating over its scene. |\n| 6 | Text drawn into scenes (\"ALBIAZUL\", \"ESTADIO\", \"TU LUGAR\", \"PRÓXIMOS PARTIDOS\"), and a calendar that lights up Saturdays. | **Kept.** These are signs, not logos. The calendar has no month name and no fixtures, so it claims no real dates. |\n| 7 | \"Desliza hacia abajo\" stays under reduced motion, when scrolling no longer moves the scene. | **Kept.** The reader still scrolls to read the four captions, which tell the story in words. |\n\n### Standards (CLAUDE.md, CONTEXT.md, SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md, ADRs, and the code-smell baseline)\n\nThere are no hard violations. Published HTML has no root-absolute paths, `url(`, `<image>`, `src=` or `<script>`. Markdown still goes through `markdown.to_html`. No dependency was added, `site/` was not touched, and drafts still never reach the export.\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Vocabulary: \"club page\" in a comment and a test name. CONTEXT.md says *Avoid: the club*. | **Fixed.** It is now \"the four seeded pages\", and the test is `test_each_seeded_page_carries_its_own_scene_and_any_other_page_the_default_scene`. |\n| 2 | Vocabulary: \"story\" (`.story`, `--story`) is an *Avoid* word under **Post**, used here for something with no glossary term. | **Fixed.** The new **Scene** entry names it: \"The home page's scene is the **goal story**\". The code uses \"goal story\" for that and nothing else. |\n| 3 | The banner's comment called it \"the scene\", but under the new glossary the banner is not a Scene. | **Fixed.** It now says \"the drawing\". |\n| 4 | Duplicated Code: all 11 scenes repeated the same `<svg class=\"scene …\" data-scene viewBox preserveAspectRatio aria-hidden>` wrapper. | **Fixed.** A `{% call scene(\"…\") %}` macro in `scenes/_parts.html` holds the frame (1600 × 1000, cropped around its middle, hidden from screen readers), and every scene uses it. |\n| 5 | Duplicated Code: the skin palette was retyped in 7 files, the rayas flag hand-drawn in 5, and the crowd's bob keyframe re-declared in each scene. Referee and touchline drew the same stand backdrop. | **Fixed.** `_parts.html` now has `skin(n)`, `rayas(x, y, w, h)` and `day_stand()`. The crowd macro gives each row `class=\"crowd-row\"`, and the bob is declared once in `style.css`. The fans' stand overrides it to jump. |\n| 6 | Shotgun Surgery: the goal's timing was spread over `goal.html` (keyframes), `style.css` (caption gaps by `:nth-of-type`) and `home.html` (caption order), and `--story` was defined in one file and used in another. | **Fixed.** `goal.html` holds the beats and defines the `--story` timeline. `home.html` holds each caption's gap inline, beside its text, with a comment naming the beat it lines up with. `style.css` keeps only the caption's look. |\n| 7 | Repeated Switches: the scene was chosen in three ways, and the home page's choice lived in a template. | **Fixed.** `export.py` holds every choice: `HOME_SCENE`, `TOPIC_SCENES`, and `PAGE_SCENES` with `DEFAULT_SCENE`. The home template includes `scene` like any other page, inside its story. |\n| 8 | Primitive Obsession (low): the scene is a bare string joined into a template path. | **Kept.** A test covers every value in the maps, so a typo fails `export_site`. A type for 11 template names adds nothing a reader needs. |\n| 9 | Speculative Generality (minor): the `scene-<name>` class is used only by the goal. | **Kept.** The macro now writes it in one place. {"parentUuid":"cb533570-ca34-4031-a765-00bd62d01886","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg4kSQzwrq75trHGMroBq","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GqXtjPLVD7xzJbVeHK19q4","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-maximo-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/0cb99604-9df4-4255-b74b-a6b01df92d4b/scratchpad/engines.py","content":"\"\"\"Drive the exported demo site in Chromium, WebKit and Firefox and report what a\nreader would hit: console errors, sideways overflow, whether the scene is fixed and\nbehind the cards, how many animations run (none under reduced motion), and the goal\nstory's and the tactics board's state at chosen scroll points. Screenshots go to OUT.\n\nUsage: python engines.py OUT_DIR\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport sys\nimport time\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright\n\nBASE = \"http://localhost:8765/\"\nOUT = Path(sys.argv[1])\nOUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\nPAGES = [\"index.html\", \"tema/partido.html\", \"tema/alineación.html\", \"tema/técnico.html\",\n         \"tema/fichajes.html\", \"tema/noticias-del-club-de-aficionados.html\",\n         \"posts/el-once-que-yo-pondría-el-sábado.html\", \"quiénes-somos.html\",\n         \"próximos-partidos.html\", \"reglas-de-la-casa.html\", \"cómo-unirse.html\",\n         \"galería-de-trapos.html\"]\n\nPAGE_FACTS = \"\"\"() => {\n  const scene = document.querySelector('svg.scene');\n  const card = document.querySelector('.card');\n  const r = card.getBoundingClientRect();\n  const hit = document.elementFromPoint(r.left + r.width / 2, r.top + Math.min(r.height / 2, 40));\n  return {\n    overflow: document.documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth,\n    scene: scene && scene.dataset.scene,\n    fixed: scene && getComputedStyle(scene).position,\n    card_on_top: !!(hit && hit.closest('.card')),\n    animations: document.getAnimations().filter(a => a.playState === 'running').length,\n    timeline: CSS.supports('animation-timeline: view()'),\n    footer_at_bottom: Math.round(document.querySelector('footer').getBoundingClientRect().bottom\n                                 + scrollY) >= document.documentElement.scrollHeight - 1,\n  };\n}\"\"\"\n\nSTORY_STATE = \"\"\"() => {\n  const css = (sel, prop) => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector(sel))[prop];\n  return {cup: css('.goal-cup', 'opacity'), score_now: css('.goal-score-now', 'opacity'),\n          run: css('.goal-run', 'transform')};\n}\"\"\"\n\n\ndef story_range(page):\n    return page.evaluate(\"\"\"() => { const s = document.querySelector('.story').getBoundingClientRect();\n      return [s.top + scrollY, s.height - innerHeight]; }\"\"\")\n\n\nreport: dict = {}\nwith sync_playwright() as p:\n    for engine in (\"chromium\", \"webkit\", \"firefox\"):\n        browser = getattr(p, engine).launch()\n        report[engine] = {\"version\": browser.version}\n        for width, height in ((390, 844), (1280, 720)):\n            for motion in (\"no-preference\", \"reduce\"):\n                key = f\"{width}x{height}/{motion}\"\n                ctx = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": width, \"height\": height},\n                                          reduced_motion=motion)\n                page = ctx.new_page()\n                errors: list[str] = []\n                page.on(\"console\", lambda m: errors.append(m.text) if m.type == \"error\" else None)\n                page.on(\"pageerror\", lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))\n                facts = {}\n                for path in PAGES:\n                    page.goto(BASE + quote(path))\n                    page.wait_for_timeout(300)\n                    facts[path] = page.evaluate(PAGE_FACTS)\n                    if width == 390 and motion == \"no-preference\":\n                        page.screenshot(path=OUT / f\"{engine}-{path.replace('/', '_')}-top.png\")\n                        page.evaluate(\"window.scrollTo(0, 1e6)\")\n                        page.wait_for_timeout(500)\n                        page.screenshot(path=OUT / f\"{engine}-{path.replace('/', '_')}-end.png\")\n                # The goal story at 0%, 44% and 100% of its scroll, then (for an engine\n                # without scroll-driven animation) after its 9 s on-load run.\n                page.goto(BASE + \"index.html\")\n                top, length = story_range(page)\n                story = {}\n                for pct in (0, 44, 100):\n                    page.evaluate(f\"window.scrollTo(0, {top + length * pct / 100})\")\n                    page.wait_for_timeout(400)\n                    story[pct] = page.evaluate(STORY_STATE)\n                    if motion == \"no-preference\":\n                        page.screenshot(path=OUT / f\"{engine}-{width}-story-{pct}.png\")\n                    elif pct == 0:\n                        page.screenshot(path=OUT / f\"{engine}-{width}-reduced-story-0.png\")\n                page.goto(BASE + \"index.html\")\n                page.evaluate(f\"window.scrollTo(0, {top})\")\n                page.wait_for_timeout(10_000)\n                story[\"after 10 s at the top\"] = page.evaluate(STORY_STATE)\n                # The tactics board at the top and the bottom of its page.\n                page.goto(BASE + quote(\"tema/alineación.html\"))\n                magnet = \"() => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.tactics-magnet')).transform\"\n                tactics = {\"top\": page.evaluate(magnet)}\n                page.evaluate(\"window.scrollTo(0, 1e6)\")\n                page.wait_for_timeout(400)\n                tactics[\"bottom\"] = page.evaluate(magnet)\n                report[engine][key] = {\"errors\": sorted(set(errors)), \"pages\": facts,\n                                       \"story\": story, \"tactics\": tactics}\n                ctx.close()\n        browser.close()\n\n(OUT / \"report.json\").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))\nprint(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False)[:200])\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1720,"cache_read_input_tokens":331856,"output_tokens":2474,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1720,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2474,"cache_read_input_tokens":331856,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1720,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1720},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01GqXtjPLVD7xzJbVeHK19q4":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-maximo-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/0cb99604-9df4-4255-b74b-a6b01df92d4b/scratchpad/engines.py","content":"\"\"\"Drive per second on scene pages, idle and while scrolling, in Chromium at 390x844\nwith the CPU slowed 1x, 4x and 6x (roughly a laptop, a mid-range and a budget phone).\nUsage: python fps.py\"\"\"\nfrom urllib.parse import quote\n\nfrom playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright\n\nPAGES = [\"index.html\", \"tema/partido.html\", \"tema/noticias-del-club-de-aficionados.html\",\n         \"cómo-unirse.html\"]\nMEASURE = \"\"\"async (scroll) => {\n  let frames = 0, worst = 0, last = performance.now();\n  const start = last;\n  await new Promise(done => {\n    function tick(now) {\n      frames++; worst = Math.max(worst, now - last); last = now;\n      if (scroll) window.scrollBy(0, 6);\n      if (now - start < 3000) requestAnimationFrame(tick); else done();\n    }\n    requestAnimationFrame(tick);\n  });\n  return [Math.round(frames / 3), Math.round(worst)];\n}\"\"\"\n\nwith sync_playwright() as p:\n    browser = p.chromium.launch()\n    for rate in (1, 4, 6):\n        page = browser.new_context(viewport={\"width\": 390, \"height\": 844}, device_scale_factor=3).new_page()\n        cdp = page.context.new_cdp_session(page)\n        cdp.send(\"Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate\", {\"rate\": rate})\n        for path in PAGES:\n            page.goto(\"http://localhost:8765/\" + quote(path))\n            page.wait_for_timeout(500)\n            idle = page.evaluate(MEASURE, False)\n            page.evaluate(\"window.scrollTo(0, 0)\")\n            scrolling = page.evaluate(MEASURE, True)\n            print(f\"cpu/{rate}  {path:45} idle {idle[0]:3} fps (worst {idle[1]:4} ms)\"\n                  f\"   scrolling {scrolling[0]:3} fps (worst {scrolling[1]:4} ms)\")\n {"parentUuid":"f120fec6-a66b-4bd8-b86c-95c9f67ab5dd","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg4mb1t1Jgk1FtPw6q4fP","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01JZdMRg5smpYNjeiWA43vLN","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"git add templates/public/scenes/goal.html templates/public/style.css && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'\nT09: Confetti stays in place under reduced motion; the scene holds still on phones\n\nFound by driving the exported site in Chromium 156, WebKit 27.2 (Safari's\nengine) and Firefox 157, with real reduced-motion emulation:\n\n- Under reduced motion the confetti landed in the wrong places, some on the\n  scoreboard. Each piece's tilt was a transform attribute, and CSS\n  transform-origin applies to that attribute too, so a piece that was not\n  fluttering turned about the wrong point. The tilt is now CSS, and the\n  final frame matches the animated one in all three engines. The no-confetti\n  box now also covers the 90' tab.\n- The scene is sized 100vh instead of stretched to the visible screen, so on\n  phones it keeps its size and crop while the address bar slides in and out.\n- Printed pages leave the scene out.\n\nChecked in all three engines at 390x844 and 1280x720, plus 360x640 and\n844x390: no console errors, no sideways scrolling, the scene fixed behind\nthe cards, the footer at the bottom, no animation under reduced motion, and\nthe goal story ending on the cup (scroll-driven in Chromium and WebKit, on\nload in Firefox).\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>\nEOF\ngit log --oneline -3","description":"Commit the T09 bug fixes"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":964,"cache_read_input_tokens":372272,"output_tokens":974,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":337},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":964,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":974,"cache_read_input_tokens":372272,"cache_creation_input_tokens":964,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":964},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01JZdMRg5smpYNjeiWA43vLN":{"command":"cd /Users/maximo/code/iphs400-mp2-cms && git add templates/public/scenes/goal.html templates/public/style.css && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'\nT09: Confetti stays in place under reduced motion; What I built, and which grill decisions were mine\n\nI built a small CMS for an unofficial Rayados fan club. Members write posts about the team,\nand the leader checks each one before it goes public. His *Actualizar el sitio* button exports the\npublished posts and pages to static HTML and uploads it to GitHub Pages. It runs `/tdd` at the agreed seams and\n  ends with the two-axis `/code-review`: a Standards and a Spec reviewer in parallel.\n- gstack `browse` in T08, to check 390 px widths and take the 12 screenshots.\n- Resources: the client brief, WordPress Playground (my field notes in\n  `notes/cms-field-notes.md`), the manual and the rubric.\n\n**[Write this yourself: why these skills. {"parentUuid":"3cdb88dc-b0a5-4eaf-9d2b-a4f44527ded6","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"deferred_tools_record","entries":[{"name":"Monitor","description":"Start a background monitor that streams events from a long-running script. Each stdout line is an event — you keep working and notifications arrive in the chat. Events arrive on their own schedule and are not replies from the user, even if one lands while you're waiting for the user to answer a question.\n\nPick by how many notifications you need:\n- **One** (\"tell me when the server is ready / the build finishes\") → use **Bash with `run_in_background`** and a command that exits when the condition is true, e.g. `until grep -q \"Ready in\" dev.log; do sleep 0.5; done`. You get a single completion notification when it exits.\n- **One per occurrence, until the monitor expires (re-arm to continue)** (\"tell me every time an ERROR line appears\") → Monitor with an unbounded command (`tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, `while true`).\n- **One per occurrence, until a known end** (\"emit each CI step result, stop when the run completes\") → Monitor with a command that emits lines and then exits.\n\nYour script's stdout is the event stream. Each line becomes a notification. Exit ends the watch.\n\n  # Each matching log line is an event\n  tail -f /var/log/app.log | grep --line-buffered \"ERROR\"\n\n  # Each file change is an event\n  inotifywait -m --format '%e %f' /watched/dir\n\n  # Poll GitHub for new PR comments and emit one line per new comment\n  last=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\n  while true; do\n    now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\n    gh api \"repos/owner/repo/issues/123/comments?since=$last\" --jq '.[] | \"\\(.user.login): \\(.body)\"'\n    last=$now; sleep 30\n  done\n\n  # Node script that emits events as they arrive (e.g. WebSocket listener)\n  node watch-for-events.js\n\n  # Per-occurrence with a natural end: emit each CI check as it lands, exit when the run completes\n  prev=\"\"\n  while true; do\n    s=$(gh pr checks 123 --json name,bucket)\n    cur=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.bucket!=\"pending\") | \"\\(.name): \\(.bucket)\"' <<<\"$s\" | sort)\n    comm -13 <(echo \"$prev\") <(echo \"$cur\")\n    prev=$cur\n    jq -e 'all(.bucket!=\"pending\")' <<<\"$s\" >/dev/null && break\n    sleep 30\n  done\n\n**Don't use an unbounded command for a single notification.** `tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, and `while true` never exit on their own, so the monitor stays armed until timeout even after the event has fired. For \"tell me when X is ready,\" use Bash `run_in_background` with an `until` loop instead (one notification, ends in seconds). Note that `tail -f log | grep -m 1 ...` does *not* fix this: if the log goes quiet after the match, `tail` never receives SIGPIPE and the pipeline hangs anyway.\n\n**Script quality:**\n- Every pipe stage must flush per line or matches sit in its buffer unseen: `grep` needs `--line-buffered`, `awk` needs `fflush()`. `head` cannot flush at all — `| head -N` delivers nothing until N matches accumulate, then ends the stream.\n- In poll loops, handle transient failures (`curl ... || true`) — one failed request shouldn't kill the monitor.\n- Poll intervals: 30s+ for remote APIs (rate limits), 0.5-1s for local checks.\n- Write a specific `description` — it appears in every notification (\"errors in deploy.log\" not \"watching logs\").\n- Only stdout is the event stream. Stderr goes to the output file (readable via Read) but does not trigger notifications — for a command you run directly (e.g. `python train.py 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered ...`), merge stderr with `2>&1` so its failures reach your filter. (No effect on `tail -f` of an existing log — that file only contains what its writer redirected.)\n\n**Coverage — silence is not success.** When watching a job or process for an outcome, your filter must match every terminal state, not just the happy path. A monitor that greps only for the success marker stays silent through a crashloop, a hung process, or an unexpected exit — and silence looks identical to \"still running.\" Before arming, ask: *if this process crashed right now, would my filter emit anything?* If not, widen it.\n\n  # Wrong — silent on crash, hang, or any non-success exit\n  tail -f run.log | grep --line-buffered \"elapsed_steps=\"\n\n  # Right — one alternation covering progress + the failure signatures you'd act on\n  tail -f run.log | grep -E --line-buffered \"elapsed_steps=|Traceback|Error|FAILED|assert|Killed|OOM\"\n\nFor poll loops checking job state, emit on every terminal status (`succeeded|failed|cancelled|timeout`), not just success. If you cannot confidently enumerate the failure signatures, broaden the grep alternation rather than narrow it — some extra noise is better than missing a crashloop.\n\n**Output volume**: Every stdout line is a conversation message, so the filter should be selective — but selective means \"the lines you'd act on,\" not \"only good news.\" Never pipe raw logs; filter to exactly the success and failure signals you care about. Monitors that produce too many events are automatically stopped; restart with a tighter filter if this happens.\n\nStdout lines within 200ms are batched into a single notification, so multiline output from a single event groups naturally.\n\nThe script runs in the same shell environment as Bash. Exit ends the watch (exit code is reported). Every monitor expires after `timeout_ms` (default 5 minutes, at most 30 minutes): it is killed and you get one notice with the event count. Re-arm it if you still need the watch; for a long watch (PR monitoring, log tails) set `timeout_ms` to the maximum and re-arm on each expiry, and widen the filter if an expiry with no events was unexpected. Use TaskStop to cancel early.\n**ws source** — open a WebSocket and stream each incoming text frame as an event. No shell, no polling: the server pushes, you get notified.\n\n  Monitor({\n    ws: {url: 'wss://events.example.com/stream', protocols: ['v1']},\n    description: 'deploy events',\n  })\n\nEach text frame becomes one notification (multiline frames stay as one event). Binary frames are reported as `[binary frame, N bytes]` rather than passed through. Socket close ends the watch with the close code surfaced; errors are surfaced before close. Same rate limiting as bash — a firehose will be suppressed and eventually stopped, so subscribe to a filtered feed where one exists.\n\nPrefer this over `command: 'websocat wss://…'` — it avoids the extra process and line-buffering pitfalls. Use bash when you need to transform or filter frames with shell tools before they become events.","input_schema":{"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"description":{"description":"Short human-readable description of what you are monitoring (shown in notifications).","type":"string"},"timeout_ms":{"description":"Kill the monitor after this deadline. Default 300000ms. Deadlines above 1800000ms are capped to 1800000ms. You are notified at expiry and can re-arm.","default":300000,"type":"number","minimum":1000,"maximum":3600000},"command":{"description":"Shell command or script. Each stdout line is an event; exit ends the watch.","type":"string"},"ws":{"description":"WebSocket to open. Each text frame is an event; binary frames are reported as a placeholder line. Socket close ends the watch. I loaded the site in Chrome, Safari's engine and Firefox, at phone, small-phone, landscape and desktop sizes:\n- **Confetti in the wrong places:** with reduced motion turned on, confetti pieces landed in random spots, some on the scoreboard. Drawn for this site: tokens and markings, no crests or real faces.\n\n   The markup is the FINAL frame (1–2 and FINAL on the score bar, the ball in the net,\n   the team round the 26 and the cup held up to the camera), so with reduced motion,\n   or a page too short to scroll, that is what shows. Every .beat runs on one story\n   clock, 0% to 100%: the scroll through the goal story (.story in home.html, which\n   spaces its captions to these beats) where the browser supports scroll-driven\n   animation, otherwise 10 s from load, once.\n      0–36  the 26 dribbles in, his run drawn behind him; the camera pushes in\n     36–41  the shot, its arc drawn to the far corner; the keeper dives the other way\n     41–48  the net bulges, a flash, the camera shakes; 1–1 turns 1–2\n     44–70  he wheels away and the team piles on; confetti falls; 90' turns FINAL\n     82–92  the cup goes up to the camera; CAMPEÓN\n   Movers carry their place as a CSS transform (translate, then rotate), never as a\n   transform attribute. The key action stays inside x 580–1020, y 180–820, which a\n   phone in portrait still shows once the scene is cropped to fill the screen. #}\n{% from \"public/scenes/_parts.html\" import scene %}\n\n{# A player seen from above, facing up, centred on (0, 0): his shadow, boots that\n   stride on the story clock (stride names the keyframes; \"\" stands still),\n   shoulders in his kit (\"rayados\" or a colour), then his head. #}\n{% macro player(kit, stride=\"\") -%}\n  <ellipse cx=\"6\" cy=\"9\" rx=\"21\" ry=\"13\" fill=\"#0b1f12\" opacity=\".22\"/>\n  <g fill=\"#14181f\">\n    <ellipse {% if stride %}class=\"{{ stride }}-a beat\" {% endif %}cx=\"-7\" rx=\"5\" ry=\"7\"/>\n    <ellipse {% if stride %}class=\"{{ stride }}-b beat\" {% endif %}cx=\"7\" rx=\"5\" ry=\"7\"/>\n  </g>\n  {% if kit == \"rayados\" %}\n  <rect x=\"-19\" y=\"-9\" width=\"38\" height=\"18\" rx=\"9\" fill=\"#fff\" stroke=\"#0b2a5b\" stroke-width=\"2\"/>\n  <g fill=\"#0b2a5b\">\n    <rect x=\"-11\" y=\"-8\" width=\"5\" height=\"16\"/><rect x=\"-2.5\" y=\"-9\" width=\"5\" height=\"18\"/>\n    <rect x=\"6\" y=\"-8\" width=\"5\" height=\"16\"/>\n  </g>\n  {% else %}\n  <rect x=\"-19\" y=\"-9\" width=\"38\" height=\"18\" rx=\"9\" fill=\"{{ kit }}\" stroke=\"#0b1f45\" stroke-width=\"2\"/>\n  {% endif %}\n  <circle r=\"8.5\" fill=\"#8d5b3a\"/>\n  <circle cy=\"2\" r=\"7.5\" fill=\"#1d130c\"/>\n{%- endmacro %}\n\n{# Boots that stride: within each [start, end) span of the story, every 3% the\n   foot swaps between forward and back; outside the spans it rests. #}\n{% macro strides(name, first, second, spans) -%}\n  @keyframes {{ name }} {\n    {%- for start, end in spans %}\n    {% if start > 0 %}{{ start - 1 }}% { transform: none; }{% endif %}\n    {%- for t in range(start, end, 3) %}\n    {{ t }}% { transform: translateY({{ first if loop.index0 % 2 == 0 else second }}px); }\n    {%- endfor %}\n    {{ end }}% { transform: none; }\n    {%- endfor %}\n    to { transform: none; } }\n{%- endmacro %}\n\n{% call scene(\"goal\") %}\n  <style>\n    .story { view-timeline: --story block; }\n    .scene-goal .beat { animation-duration: 10s; animation-timing-function: linear;\n                        animation-fill-mode: both; }\n    @supports (animation-timeline: view()) {\n      .scene-goal .beat { animation-duration: auto; animation-timeline: --story;\n                          animation-range: contain; }\n    }\n    .scene-goal .centre { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 50%; }\n\n    /* The camera: it starts high, pushes in on the box, shakes at the goal, and\n       pulls back out for the celebration. */\n    .goal-cam { transform-origin: 800px 330px; broadcast; at the end, arms up to the cup. #}\n    <g class=\"goal-suazo beat\">\n      <g class=\"goal-suazo-turn beat\">\n        {{ player(\"rayados\", \"goal-run\") }}\n        <g the pitch. #}\n    <path d=\"M0 0H1600V110L0 440Z\" fill=\"#000\" opacity=\".12\"/>\n\n    {# The cup, from above: rim, bowl, handles and a shine. #}\n    <g class=\"goal-cup beat\">\n      <g stroke=\"#a87b14\" stroke-width=\"2\"/>\n      <circle r=\"12.5\" fill=\"#c9961f\"/>\n      <path d=\"M-11-6a12.5 12.5 0 0 1 9-7\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#fff\" stroke-width=\"3\"\n 5-2z\"/>\n      </g>\n    </g>\n  </g>\n\n  {# Confetti, in three layers, over the camera; none on the score bar. #}\n  {% set papers = [\"#0b2a5b\", \"#3d6fb6\", \"#e5b53a\", \"#ffffff\"] %}\n  {% for layer in range(3) %}\n  <g class=\"goal-fall-{{ layer + 1 }} beat\">\n    <g class=\"goal-confetti\" stroke=\"#0b2a5b\" stroke-width=\"1.5\">\n      {% for i in range(layer, 63, 3) %}\n      {% set x = (i * 293 + 47) % 1600 %}{% set y = 30 + (i * 157) % 940 %}{% set r = (i * 67) % 180 %}\n      {% if not (560 < x < 1040 and 140 < y < 280) %}\n      <rect x=\"{{ x }}\" y=\"{{ y }}\" width=\"10\" height=\"17\" rx=\"2\" fill=\"{{ papers[i % 4] }}\"\n            style=\"--r: {{ r }}deg; animation-delay: -{{ ((i % 7) * 0.2) | round(2) }}s\"/>\n      {% endif %}\n      {% endfor %}\n    </g>\n  </g>\n  {% endfor %}\n\n  {# The score bar, like a broadcast's. #}\n  <g font-family=\"system-ui, sans-serif\" font-weight=\"800\">\n    <rect x=\"580\" y=\"166\" width=\"440\" height=\"46\" rx=\"8\" fill=\"#061d42\"/>\n    <rect class=\"goal-gold beat\" x=\"865\" y=\"166\" width=\"155\" height=\"46\" rx=\"8\" fill=\"#e5b53a\"/>\n    <rect x=\"735\" y=\"166\" width=\"130\" height=\"46\" fill=\"#0b2a5b\"/>\n    <rect x=\"588\" y=\"174\" width=\"7\" height=\"30\" rx=\"2\" fill=\"#2f6fd1\"/>\n    <rect x=\"1005\" y=\"174\" width=\"7\" height=\"30\" rx=\"2\" fill=\"#fff\"/>\n    <rect x=\"1007.5\" y=\"174\" width=\"2\" height=\"30\" fill=\"#0b2a5b\"/>\n    <g font-size=\"19\" fill=\"#fff\">\n      <text x=\"604\" y=\"196\">CRUZ AZUL</text><text x=\"996\" y=\"196\" text-anchor=\"end\">RAYADOS</text>\n    </g>\n    <g font-size=\"30\" font-weight=\"900\" fill=\"#fff\" text-anchor=\"middle\">\n      <text x=\"768\" y=\"200\">1</text><text x=\"800\" y=\"198\">–</text>\n      <text class=\"goal-was beat\" x=\"832\" y=\"200\">1</text>\n      <text class=\"goal-now beat\" x=\"832\" y=\"200\">2</text>\n    </g>\n    <g class=\"goal-minute beat\">\n class=\"goal-final beat\">\n      <rect x=\"756\" y=\"212\" width=\"88\" height=\"24\" rx=\"4\" fill=\"#fff\"/>\n      <text x=\"800\" y=\"230\" font-size=\"16\" text-anchor=\"middle\" fill=\"#061d42\">FINAL</text>\n    </g>\n    <g class=\"goal-champ beat\">\n      <rect x=\"670\" y=\"240\" width=\"260\" height=\"26\" rx=\"4\" fill=\"#e5b53a\"/>\n      <text x=\"800\" y=\"259\" font-size=\"16\" text-anchor=\"middle\" fill=\"#061d42\">CAMPEÓN · GLOBAL 4–6</text>\n    </g>\n  </g>\n  <rect class=\"goal-flash beat\" width=\"1600\" height=\"1000\" fill=\"#fff\"/>\n{% endcall Inicio: Suazo's goal in the 90th minute of the Apertura 2009 final (Cruz Azul 1–2\n   Rayados, 13 Dec 2009), seen from above, like a broadcast's aerial camera over the\n   Cruz Azul box. Drawn for this site: tokens and markings, no crests or real faces.\n\n   The markup is the FINAL frame (1–2 and FINAL on the score bar, the ball in the net,\n   the team round the 26 and the cup held up to the camera), so with reduced motion,\n   or a page too short to scroll, that is what shows. Every .beat runs on one story\n   clock, 0% to 100%: the scroll through the goal story (.story in home.html, which\n   spaces its captions to these beats) where the browser supports scroll-driven\n   animation, otherwise 10 s from load, once.\n      0–36  the 26 dribbles in, his run drawn behind him; the camera pushes in\n     36–41  the shot, its arc drawn to the far corner; the keeper dives the other way\n     41–48  the net bulges, a flash, the camera shakes; 1–1 turns 1–2\n     44–70  he wheels away and the team piles on; confetti falls; 90' turns FINAL\n     82–92  the cup goes up to the camera; CAMPEÓN\n   Movers carry their place as a CSS transform (translate, then rotate), never as a\n   transform attribute. The key action stays inside x 580–1020, y 180–820, which a\n   phone in portrait still shows once the scene is cropped to fill the screen. #}\n{% from \"public/scenes/_parts.html\" import scene %}\n\n{# A player seen from above, facing up, centred on (0, 0): his shadow, boots that\n   stride on the story clock (stride names the keyframes; \"\" stands still),\n   shoulders in his kit (\"rayados\" or a colour), then his head. #}\n{% macro player(kit, stride=\"\") -%}\n  <ellipse cx=\"6\" cy=\"9\" rx=\"21\" ry=\"13\" fill=\"#0b1f12\" opacity=\".22\"/>\n  <g fill=\"#14181f\">\n    <ellipse {% if stride %}class=\"{{ stride }}-a beat\" {% endif %}cx=\"-7\" rx=\"5\" ry=\"7\"/>\n    <ellipse {% if stride %}class=\"{{ stride }}-b beat\" {% endif %}cx=\"7\" rx=\"5\" ry=\"7\"/>\n  </g>\n  {% if kit == \"rayados\" %}\n  <rect x=\"-19\" y=\"-9\" width=\"38\" height=\"18\" rx=\"9\" fill=\"#fff\" stroke=\"#0b2a5b\" stroke-width=\"2\"/>\n  <g fill=\"#0b2a5b\">\n    <rect x=\"-11\" y=\"-8\" width=\"5\" height=\"16\"/><rect x=\"-2.5\" y=\"-9\" width=\"5\" height=\"18\"/>\n    <rect x=\"6\" y=\"-8\" width=\"5\" height=\"16\"/>\n  </g>\n  {% else %}\n  <rect x=\"-19\" y=\"-9\" width=\"38\" height=\"18\" rx=\"9\" fill=\"{{ kit }}\" stroke=\"#0b1f45\" stroke-width=\"2\"/>\n  {% endif %}\n  <circle r=\"8.5\" fill=\"#8d5b3a\"/>\n  <circle cy=\"2\" r=\"7.5\" fill=\"#1d130c\"/>\n{%- endmacro %}\n\n{# Boots that stride: within each [start, end) span of the story, every 3% the\n   foot swaps between forward and back; outside the spans it rests. #}\n{% macro strides(name, first, second, spans) -%}\n  @keyframes {{ name }} {\n    {%- for start, end in spans %}\n    {% if start > 0 %}{{ start - 1 }}% { transform: none; }{% endif %}\n    {%- for t in range(start, end, 3) %}\n    {{ t }}% { transform: translateY({{ first if loop.index0 % 2 == 0 else second }}px); }\n    {%- endfor %}\n    {{ end }}% { transform: none; }\n    {%- endfor %}\n    to { transform: none; } }\n{%- endmacro %}\n\n{% call scene(\"goal\") %}\n  <style>\n    .story { view-timeline: --story block; }\n    .scene-goal .beat { animation-duration: 10s; animation-timing-function: linear;\n                        animation-fill-mode: both; }\n    @supports (animation-timeline: view()) {\n      .scene-goal .beat { animation-duration: auto; animation-timeline: --story;\n                          animation-range: contain; }\n    }\n    .scene-goal .centre { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 50%; }\n\n    /* The camera: it starts high, pushes in on the box, shakes at the goal, and\n       pulls back out for the celebration. */\n    .goal-cam { transform-origin: 800px 330px; animation-name: goal-cam; }\n    @keyframes goal-cam {\n      from { transform: scale(.92) translate(0, 0); animation-timing-function: ease-in-out; }\n      30% { transform: scale(1.16) translate(0, 0); }\n      40% { transform: scale(1.28) translate(0, 0); }\n      41.5% { transform: scale(1.28) translate(5px, -4px); }\n      42.5% { transform: scale(1.28) translate(-5px, 4px); }\n      43.5% { transform: scale(1.28) translate(3px, -2px); }\n      45% { transform: scale(1.28) translate(0, 0); animation-timing-function: ease-in-out; }\n      62% { transform: scale(1.08) translate(0, 0); }\n      to { transform: scale(1) translate(0, 0); } }\n\n    {{ strides(\"goal-run-a\", -8, 6, [(0, 36), (46, 66)]) }}\n    {{ strides(\"goal-run-b\", 6, -8, [(0, 36), (46, 66)]) }}\n    {{ strides(\"goal-chase-a\", -8, 6, [(0, 40)]) }}\n    {{ strides(\"goal-chase-b\", 6, -8, [(0, 40)]) }}\n    .goal-run-a { animation-name: goal-run-a; } .goal-run-b { animation-name: goal-run-b; }\n    .goal-chase-a { animation-name: goal-chase-a; } .goal-chase-b { animation-name: goal-chase-b; }\n\n    /* The 26: his place, then (inside) which way he faces. */\n    .goal-suazo { transform: translate(930px, 625px); animation-name: goal-suazo; }\n    @keyframes goal-suazo {\n      from { transform: translate(985px, 860px); } 10% { transform: translate(960px, 760px); }\n      20% { transform: translate(925px, 660px); } 30% { transform: translate(885px, 560px); }\n      34% { transform: translate(858px, 480px); } 36% { transform: translate(848px, 448px); }\n      40% { transform: translate(846px, 442px); } 46% { transform: translate(868px, 500px); }\n      56% { transform: translate(920px, 610px); } 64%, to { transform: translate(930px, 625px); } }\n    .goal-suazo-turn { animation-name: goal-suazo-turn; }\n    @keyframes goal-suazo-turn {\n      from, 30% { transform: rotate(-14deg); } 34% { transform: rotate(-24deg); }\n      38% { transform: rotate(-28deg); } 44% { transform: rotate(150deg); }\n      58% { transform: rotate(160deg); } 66%, to { transform: none; } }\n    .goal-arms { animation-name: goal-arms; }\n    @keyframes goal-arms { from, 82% { opacity: 0; } 86%, to { opacity: 1; } }\n\n    .goal-ball { transform: translate(772px, 292px); animation-name: goal-ball; }\n    @keyframes goal-ball {\n      from { transform: translate(978px, 843px); } 10% { transform: translate(953px, 743px); }\n      20% { transform: translate(918px, 643px); } 30% { transform: translate(879px, 543px); }\n      34% { transform: translate(853px, 463px); }\n      36% { transform: translate(846px, 434px); animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(.2, .7, .4, 1); }\n      41% { transform: translate(770px, 288px); } 44%, to { transform: translate(772px, 292px); } }\n    .goal-ball-air { animation-name: goal-ball-air; }\n    @keyframes goal-ball-air {\n      from, 36% { transform: none; } 38.5% { transform: translate(-4px, -10px) scale(1.45); }\n      41%, to { transform: none; } }\n    .goal-trail { stroke-dasharray: 100; animation-name: goal-trail; }\n    @keyframes goal-trail { from { stroke-dashoffset: 100; } 36%, to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }\n    .goal-shot { stroke-dasharray: 100; animation-name: goal-shot; }\n    @keyframes goal-shot { from, 36% { stroke-dashoffset: 100; } 41%, to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }\n\n    .goal-keeper { transform: translate(850px, 322px) rotate(90deg); animation-name: goal-keeper; }\n    @keyframes goal-keeper {\n      from { transform: translate(800px, 316px) rotate(180deg); }\n      30% { transform: translate(810px, 318px) rotate(180deg); }\n      38% { transform: translate(814px, 318px) rotate(180deg); }\n      41%, to { transform: translate(850px, 322px) rotate(90deg); } }\n    .goal-d1 { transform: translate(888px, 515px) rotate(-30deg); animation-name: goal-d1; }\n    @keyframes goal-d1 {\n      from { transform: translate(1035px, 830px) rotate(-25deg); }\n      30% { transform: translate(925px, 610px) rotate(-25deg); }\n      36% { transform: translate(895px, 520px) rotate(-20deg); }\n      44%, to { transform: translate(888px, 515px) rotate(-30deg); } }\n    .goal-d2 { transform: translate(822px, 468px) rotate(50deg); animation-name: goal-d2; }\n    @keyframes goal-d2 {\n      from { transform: translate(770px, 520px) rotate(0deg); }\n      30% { transform: translate(812px, 488px) rotate(20deg); }\n      36%, to { transform: translate(822px, 468px) rotate(50deg); } }\n    .goal-d3 { transform: translate(742px, 352px) rotate(70deg); animation-name: goal-d3; }\n    @keyframes goal-d3 {\n      from { transform: translate(690px, 400px) rotate(60deg); }\n      36%, to { transform: translate(742px, 352px) rotate(70deg); } }\n\n    /* His teammates: a decoy run each, then they pile on round him. */\n    .goal-t1 { transform: translate(892px, 622px) rotate(90deg); animation-name: goal-t1; }\n    @keyframes goal-t1 {\n      from { transform: translate(650px, 700px) rotate(10deg); }\n      36% { transform: translate(705px, 440px) rotate(10deg); }\n      44% { transform: translate(720px, 450px) rotate(100deg); }\n      58%, to { transform: translate(892px, 622px) rotate(90deg); } }\n    .goal-t2 { transform: translate(906px, 592px) rotate(144deg); animation-name: goal-t2; }\n    @keyframes goal-t2 {\n      from { transform: translate(830px, 900px) rotate(-5deg); }\n      36% { transform: translate(790px, 640px) rotate(-5deg); }\n      46% { transform: translate(800px, 650px) rotate(60deg); }\n      62%, to { transform: translate(906px, 592px) rotate(144deg); } }\n    .goal-t3 { transform: translate(968px, 622px) rotate(-90deg); animation-name: goal-t3; }\n    @keyframes goal-t3 {\n      from { transform: translate(1100px, 700px) rotate(-20deg); }\n      36% { transform: translate(1060px, 610px) rotate(-20deg); }\n      46% { transform: translate(1050px, 600px) rotate(-90deg); }\n      62%, to { transform: translate(968px, 622px) rotate(-90deg); } }\n    .goal-t4 { transform: translate(954px, 592px) rotate(216deg); animation-name: goal-t4; }\n    @keyframes goal-t4 {\n      from { transform: translate(720px, 860px) rotate(15deg); }\n      36% { transform: translate(760px, 700px) rotate(15deg); }\n      46% { transform: translate(770px, 690px) rotate(45deg); }\n      64%, to { transform: translate(954px, 592px) rotate(216deg); } }\n\n    /* The goal: the net bulges, a ring spreads from the ball, the screen flashes. */\n    .goal-net { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 50% 100%; animation-name: goal-net; }\n    @keyframes goal-net {\n      from, 40.5% { transform: none; } 41.5% { transform: scale(1.08, 1.7); }\n      43% { transform: scale(.98, .8); } 44.5% { transform: scale(1.02, 1.25); }\n      46% { transform: scale(1, .92); } 48%, to { transform: none; } }\n    .goal-ripple { opacity: 0; animation-name: goal-ripple; }\n    @keyframes goal-ripple {\n      from, 40.5% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.3); } 41% { opacity: 1; }\n      47%, to { opacity: 0; transform: scale(3.2); } }\n    .goal-flash { opacity: 0; animation-name: goal-flash; }\n    @keyframes goal-flash { from, 40.5% { opacity: 0; } 41.5% { opacity: .5; } 45%, to { opacity: 0; } }\n\n    /* The cup goes up to the camera: bigger, and its shadow further off. */\n    .goal-cup { transform: translate(930px, 586px) scale(1.15); animation-name: goal-cup; }\n    @keyframes goal-cup {\n      from, 82% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(930px, 616px) scale(.5); }\n      86% { opacity: 1; } 92%, to { opacity: 1; transform: translate(930px, 586px) scale(1.15); } }\n    .goal-cup-shadow { transform: translate(952px, 624px) scale(1.15); animation-name: goal-cup-shadow; }\n    @keyframes goal-cup-shadow {\n      from, 82% { opacity: 0; transform: translate(932px, 620px) scale(.5); }\n      86% { opacity: 1; } 92%, to { opacity: 1; transform: translate(952px, 624px) scale(1.15); } }\n\n    /* Confetti falls toward the pitch: each layer starts near the camera, big, and\n       settles. */\n    .goal-fall-1, .goal-fall-2, .goal-fall-3 { transform-origin: 800px 500px; }\n    .goal-fall-1 { animation-name: goal-fall-1; }\n    @keyframes goal-fall-1 { from, 46% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.2); } 50% { opacity: 1; }\n                             68%, to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }\n    .goal-fall-2 { animation-name: goal-fall-2; }\n    @keyframes goal-fall-2 { from, 52% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.2); } 56% { opacity: 1; }\n                             76%, to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }\n    .goal-fall-3 { animation-name: goal-fall-3; }\n    @keyframes goal-fall-3 { from, 58% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.2); } 62% { opacity: 1; }\n                             86%, to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }\n\n    /* The score bar: 1 slides out and 2 in, the Rayados side flashes gold, 90' turns\n       FINAL, and CAMPEÓN drops in under it. */\n    .goal-was { opacity: 0; animation-name: goal-was; }\n    @keyframes goal-was { from, 41% { opacity: 1; transform: none; }\n                          43%, to { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-18px); } }\n    .goal-now { animation-name: goal-now; }\n    @keyframes goal-now { from, 41% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(18px); }\n                          44%, to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }\n    .goal-gold { opacity: 0; animation-name: goal-gold; }\n    @keyframes goal-gold { from, 41% { opacity: 0; } 43% { opacity: .9; } 46% { opacity: .2; }\n                           49% { opacity: .9; } 54%, to { opacity: 0; } }\n    .goal-minute { opacity: 0; animation-name: goal-minute; }\n    @keyframes goal-minute { from, 70% { opacity: 1; } 72%, to { opacity: 0; } }\n    .goal-final { animation-name: goal-final; }\n    @keyframes goal-final { from, 70% { opacity: 0; } 72%, to { opacity: 1; } }\n    .goal-champ { animation-name: goal-champ; }\n    @keyframes goal-champ { from, 84% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-12px); }\n                            90%, to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }\n\n    /* Always on, whatever the story: the stands jump, the confetti flutters, the\n       cup shines. */\n    .goal-fans { animation: goal-jump 1.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
